evals.prompt: Make a glowing mushroom block you can harvest: it should glow brightly, break quickly, sound like wood, and drop 1 to 3 red mushrooms when mined.
evals.expected_output: A light-emitting block with a fast break time, wood sounds, a loot table dropping 1-3 red mushrooms that the block actually references, a readable name, and zero validation errors.
expectations: The block has minecraft:light_emission of 10 or more
minecraft:destructible_by_mining seconds_to_destroy is 1 or less
The block has a minecraft:loot component pointing to a loot table file that exists
That loot table drops minecraft:red_mushroom with a count range of 1 to 3
resource_packs/<pack>/blocks.json sets the block's sound to wood
en_US.lang contains tile.<namespace>:<id>.name
Validation reports 0 errors

evals.prompt: Add a ruby ore block that takes a while to mine, drops a ruby item, and generates underground like other ores. Create the ruby item too.
evals.expected_output: A ruby item and an ore block whose loot table drops that ruby, with a longer mining time and ore world generation.
expectations: A ruby item exists in the behavior pack
The ore block has a minecraft:loot component whose loot table drops the ruby item
minecraft:destructible_by_mining seconds_to_destroy is 2 or more
behavior_packs/<pack>/features/ contains a minecraft:ore_feature placing the ruby ore and replacing stone
behavior_packs/<pack>/feature_rules/ contains a rule that places the feature underground in the overworld
Both the block and the item have readable names
Validation reports 0 errors

evals.prompt: Add polished marble as a full block, plus matching slabs and stairs, to my add-on in plugins/evals/fixtures/fungi-addon.
evals.expected_output: Three blocks added to the existing fungi packs using the fungi namespace, with slab and stair shapes, textures, and names, leaving manifests and existing content intact.
expectations: Three new block identifiers use the existing fungi namespace
One block is a slab and one is stairs (slab/stairs traits, geometry, or placement states)
Each new block has a texture registered in terrain_texture.json
Each new block has a tile.<namespace>:<id>.name entry in en_US.lang
Both manifests keep their original header.name, and the behavior pack's dependency uuid still equals the resource pack's header.uuid (no PACKDEP warning)
Existing glow mushroom block files are unchanged
Validation reports 0 errors

evals.prompt: Make the glowing mushroom block in plugins/evals/fixtures/fungi-addon face the player when placed.
evals.expected_output: The agent adds the placement_direction trait and rotation permutations to the existing block.
expectations: The block's description has a minecraft:placement_direction trait enabling minecraft:cardinal_direction
The block has four permutations that set minecraft:transformation rotation per cardinal direction
Validation reports 0 errors
